jobs.title: Market Strategy & Planning Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Job Location
HO CHI MINH CITY OFFICE
Job Description
Trước khi gửi hồ sơ ứng tuyển, bạn cần đọc và hoàn tất THƯ THÔNG BÁO & BIỂU MẪU ĐỒNG Ý TRAO QUYỀN XỬ LÝ DỮ LIỆU CÁ NHÂN DÀNH CHO ỨNG VIÊN tại ĐÂY . P&G chỉ có thể tiếp tục xử lý hồ sơ ứng tuyển sau khi nhận được sự đồng ý theo yêu cầu. Nếu bạn không đồng ý, P&G sẽ không thể tiếp tục xử lý hoặc xem xét hồ sơ ứng tuyển của bạn cho vị trí này.
----------------------------------------------------------------------

P&G is a leading global consumer goods company whose winning brands are built around the model of innovation. Whatever your passion is, we want to ignite your potential to become your very best self. We hold true to our purpose, values and principles as we seek to make a difference in the world around us. You will engage in meaningful work that will touch the lives of others and have a real impact. Everything at P&G starts with understanding - understanding our consumers and our employees as we innovate to improve lives now and for generations to come.

As a Marketing & Strategy Planning Manager at P&G, you will be one of our key drivers behind our continued growth and success! With our commitment to innovation, it's you who will develop go-to-market commercial plans for the P&G brands for Vietnam Market.

What success looks like
- Search and reapply shown success models with the different regions.

- Create Strong Conceptual Sell for our Field Sales to sell to our customers.

- Build market/regional knowledge by sharing initiative progress and competitive review.

Responsibilities
- Develop winning commercial plans to enable Sales teams to win in stores and drive local Go-to-Market & Sales Fundamentals strategies to win with customers.

- Lead deployment of agreed regional strategies, key business priorities and regional master plan to the Key Account Managers/Market Development Managers.

- Define and deliver regional sales fundamentals and business targets.

- Track promotion efficiency, ROI/cost-event analysis to ensure the best outcome for our in-market investments.

- Contribute to stewardship conformity giving clear mentorship on compliant spending to ensure the best use of budgets and no control outages.

Job Qualifications
- Expertise of operations at 1) Joint Business Planning (JBP) meetings with key customers and 2) the shopper-based design/key sales fundamental (counter location and size) to provide clear guidance to Sales team to drive the best in-store execution.

- Deep understanding of commercial planning and processes.

- Understanding of Vietnam Market through understanding consumers and customers’ needs and wants for the channel and store level.

- Expertise in retail promotion planning and execution to reflect in future planning.

- High proficiency in English and remote communication.

- Proven ability to communicate, present and influence credibly and optimally to external and internal stakeholders.

- Flexibility in field travel

- Exp 3-5 years in Market Strategy and Planning

- E-commerce experience is an advantage

At P&G, we don't just offer a job, we provide a career with diverse assignments and numerous development opportunities to groom our future leaders!

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager (Experienced)
jobs.description:
Job Location
CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES
Job Description
Ready to make an impact with a world-class Finance & Accounting team? Join a global industry leader where your expertise will help shape business decisions, drive growth, and influence the future of our organization.

At P&G, we believe that diverse experiences help build strong leaders. Mobility is a key component of many management careers, providing opportunities to grow through different assignments, locations, and business challenges. Candidates should be prepared to consider relocation opportunities throughout their career as business needs and development opportunities arise.

Finance & Accounting at P&G plays a leadership role in strategy setting, decision-making, business planning and analysis across all aspects of the business. In addition, we lead Company efforts in Tax, Treasury, M&A, Corporate Strategy, Accounting and Internal Controls. You will work as the finance leader on a multi-functional team responsible for a brand, a service, or a key project. Within these teams, you will find tight-knit collaboration among team members and an environment where your perspectives are valued. The focus is to win as a team with strong individual contributions.

Your career is filled with meaningful, and diverse assignments intended to sharpen and expand your functional skills while building out your broader business and leadership skills. We focus on your development. Early in your career, there is a rotational assignment model where employees change assignments every 2 to 3 years. Over the course of your career, you will likely work in all areas including: Brand/Region/Global Business Divisions, Corporate Financial Planning & Analysis, Supply Chain Finance, Sales Finance, Corporate Shared Services Finance and Research & Development Finance. As you progress, you may have the opportunity to work globally – via business travel or to complete a 3 to 4-year assignment in Europe, Asia, Middle East / Africa or Latin America. If you prefer, you may also choose to “specialize” in a certain area like Tax, Treasury, Accounting or Internal Controls. This enables you to become a “subject matter” authority for the Company. We want to build the career path that is right for you.

We are invested in your success. Nearly all Senior Leaders started at entry level. Our “promote from within” approach requires us to do more. Along with meaningful assignments, you will be strongly supported from your manager, mentors and peers. You will receive training to help build your skills beyond what you will learn in your current assignment and to help advance your development as a leader in the company.

We want you to join us for a career and not just an assignment. We value our employee’s well-being and know work-life balance is a critical part of you performing at your peak over the long haul. We offer a compensation package designed to be competitive with the top companies across the US.

Job Qualifications
If   you’re a good fit, you must have:
- Excellent leadership skills.  We are looking for the “very best” with proven track records of success.
- 3+ years of professional work experience.
- A major or concentration in any of these areas – Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, Commerce, or Taxation

Starting Pay/Salary Range: $110,000 – 165,300

Compensation for roles at P&G varies depending on a wide array of non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, degree/credentials, relevant skill set, and level of relevant experience. At P&G compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. Total rewards at P&G include salary + bonus (if applicable) + benefits.  Your recruiter may be able to share more about our total rewards offerings and the specific salary range for the relevant location(s) during the hiring process.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Immigration Sponsorship is not available for this role. For more information regarding who is eligible for hire at P&G along with other work authorization FAQ’s, please click HERE .

Procter & Gamble participates in E-Verify.

Qualified individuals will not be disadvantaged based on being unemployed.

jobs.title: 経営管理　FP&A
jobs.description:
Job Location
KOBE GO & IC - SANNOMIYA
Job Description
ご応募いただく際は、必ず 中途採用応募手続きガイド を参照の上、ご応募ください。

【仕事内容】
P&Gの経営管理部門（F&A）は、単なる会計・財務機能ではなく、事業成長と企業価値向上を実現する戦略パートナーとして、経営の中核を担っています。株主・経営者の視点に立ち、収益性の高いビジネスモデルの構築、健全な財務戦略の策定、そして長期的な事業価値の最大化を推進することがミッションです。

本ポジションは、担当いただく組織の戦略的なファイナンスビジネスパートナーとして、予算計画、コストマネジメント、および生産性向上施策をリードする役割を担います。

関係部門のリーダーと密接に連携しながら、継続的なコスト削減機会の特定・実現、リソース配分の最適化、および組織全体の生産性向上を推進します。また、財務データに基づく分析と提言を通じて、質の高い意思決定を支援し、持続的な事業成長と企業価値向上に貢献します。
P&Gならではのグローバルなベストプラクティスや標準化されたプロセスに触れながら、ファイナンスの専門性はもちろん、ビジネスリーダーとしての視座と実行力を高めていける環境です。

主な業務内容
- 財務データ並びに社内外の市場データを用いた投資ROI分析・競合分析に基づく戦略提案と実行
- リーダーシップチームに対する、中長期戦略提案
- 継続的にコスト削減の機会を分析し、実現するためにクロスファンクショナルチームをリード
- マルチファンクションチームを巻き込み、経営計画、単年度予算策定の取りまとめ、及びその実行管理
- 財務指標・KPIレポーティング、月次決算対応、コスト配分プロセスの標準化・改善を推進

【このポジションで得られること】
- 経営に近い立場で、担当組織の重要な意思決定に直接関わることができる
- 財務分析にとどまらず、戦略立案から実行推進まで一貫して担当できる
- ブランド、営業、生産、サプライチェーンなど、他職種と連携しながら事業全体にインパクトを与えられる
- グローバル水準の仕組み・知見を活用し、高い専門性とリーダーシップを磨ける
- 入社後早い段階から、大きな裁量とオーナーシップを持って活躍できる

【求める人物像】
- 数字を分析するだけでなく、分析結果をもとに課題を特定し、アクションにつなげられる方
- 多様な関係者を巻き込み、部門横断で物事を推進できる方
- 高い論理性とビジネス感覚を持ち、経営視点で意思決定を支援できる方
- 変化のある環境の中で、自らオーナーシップを持って挑戦できる方

【勤務地】
神戸

【選考プロセス】
1. 書類選考
2. オンラインテスト
3. 個人面接2回程度（オンライン）
*ご応募いただいた方にはオンラインテストのご案内が2-3営業日以内に配信されます。マイページ（候補者ホーム）より テスト配信後 1 週間以内 にオンラインテストを受検ください。受検完了いただいた方より次のステップにお進みいただきます。

【応募方法】
下の応募ボタンを押し、 「手動で応募」 を選択し、次の画面右上で「日本語」を選択後、まずはアカウントを作成して応募手続きください。ご応募の際には、 和文履歴書、和文職務経歴書 を必ずアップロードください。 全てご提出いただいていない場合は次のステップにお進みいただけませんのでご注意ください。
※ 応募の際の注意事項 /FAQ を記載した 応募ガイド  がございます。応募手続き中に不明点がございまし たら、まずはこちらをご確認ください。

Job Qualifications
- 大卒以上
-日本語ネイティブレベルもしくは日本語能力試験N1保持者
-TOEIC800点程度以上の英語力
-事業会社における財務計画立案、経営企画、戦略立案、事業計画などの業務経験もしくはコンサルティング会社での業務経験を2~4年程度お持ちの方

jobs.description:
Job Location

Job Description
P&G offers a wide variety of Finance & Accounting (F&A) career opportunities.  Our F&A Business Operations internship program offers a full experience to work and learn under one of our F&A organizations (i.e., Record to Report, Supply Chain, Payments, Banking, Treasury, Tax, Employee Services, Financial Solutions, Internal Controls, Governance, etc.) leading a project and immersing in our day-to-day operations.   Our interns will go through on-the-job training program focused on learning the P&G business operations, improving processes, and delivering results through problem-solving and analysis.

There are two career tracks in P&G, namely, the Manager track, and the Business and Technical Associates (BTA) track. This is an internship for the Business & Technical Associate (BTA) track. As a BTA at P&G, you will perform a variety of administrative, technical, and operational tasks that are essential for the company's success. They leverage expertise in different areas such as finance, purchases, human resources and sales, ensuring that P&G's products and processes are delivered efficiently.  As a BTA you will experience different roles that recognizes mastery and generalist skills and may be able to become a senior or expert specialist on the area of interest.

Meaningful work from Day 1

As a Finance & Accounting Business Operations Intern in P&G, you will get one of the best on-the-job trainings in the industry where you will:
-  Work with our P&G managers as your mentor and collaborate directly with a team.

- Be assigned goals and targets to deliver for the duration of your internship. Experience a truly global work environment interacting daily with P&Gers from different backgrounds, nationalities, and disciplines.

- Receive competitive compensation throughout your internship.

- Have the opportunity to become a full-time employee following successful completion of the program.

- Acquire continuous coaching & mentorship to help you improve your finance and knowledge skills.

- Thrive in a dynamic and respectful work environment – We live our Purpose, Values, and Principles daily. We value every individual and encourage initiatives promoting agility and work/life balance.

- Experience a friendly and supportive atmosphere at work.

- Choose flexible work arrangements.

- Experience to lead actual projects, process improvements and work with P&G Senior Executives during your mid-point and final presentations.

Job Qualifications
- You must be a penultimate or graduating student of Finance or Accounting-related courses who is available for required or voluntary Internship on January or February 2027

- You are a top talent, current university student that preferably has less than one-two years to graduate and is interested in the field of Finance and Accounting.

- You are a strong leader and takes initiative.

- You have strong learning agility and continuously challenge yourself to grow as a professional.

- You are disciplined and driven to deliver impactful results.

- You are confident and collaborates well with others.

- You have strong analytical skills, solution-oriented and passionate on process improvements and innovation.

- You are legally eligible to work in the Philippines.

Job Description
At P&G, we are uniquely positioned to handle supply chains from end to end. Starting with our raw materials through to the touch point of our brands with our customers and consumers. Here, our teams work to ensure our leading products reach stores in the right quantities, at the right time, and with perfect quality. Whether you are working on a new product launch or driving efficiency in a complex supply chain, you will face a new challenge every day that you’ll rise to each and every time, from Day 1.

Your responsibilities will vary from translating commercial strategies to product supply strategies to minimizing our environmental footprint via our supply chain strategies.

To succeed, you’ll need excellent relationship management and problem-solving skills, an entrepreneurial attitude, and operational discipline.

- You work effectively with diverse groups of people by embracing creativity, innovation, and initiative.

jobs.title: Sr Identity & Access Managements Operations Manager - Active Directory
jobs.description:
Job Location
CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES
Job Description
The Operations Manager for InfoSec IAM leads and continuously improves end-to-end service delivery for Identity and Access Management services on a regional and global basis. This role ensures secure, integrated, efficient, and reliable IAM operations that protect company information assets and align IT access with business needs.

Operations Managers are expected to:
- Deliver operational excellence through leveraging different practices such as ITIL and SRE
- Have an in-depth understanding of the service and business, and ensure that the support model and other operational requirements such as SLAs and OLAs meet the customer and partner’s expectations
- Continuously look for opportunities to drive efficiencies through standardization, automation, and simplification
- Lead the crisis management activities for complex and high impact outages.
- Participate in or are accountable for all aspects of service delivery including overall quality of service, service transition, vendor management, and service level management across critical IAM services

Job Description:
The Operations Manager for InfoSec IAM manages key IAM applications, Active Directory platforms, and supporting infrastructure used to enable secure authentication, authorization, and use of Group Policy Objects, as well as critical aspects of Company owned Entra ID. The role requires strong operational leadership, practical technical depth, and the ability to work across engineering, service delivery, vendors, security partners, and business stakeholders to maintain resilient and secure IAM services.

Your Team
This role is part of the InfoSec IAM Operations and supports global Active Directory Services, Entra ID, and related IAM capabilities. The team works across multiple regions and partners closely with Level 2 operations, Level 3 specialists, engineering, product and service owners, vendors, and security stakeholders to deliver stable, secure, and continuously improving IAM operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end operational service delivery for assigned InfoSec IAM services, ensuring service quality, reliability, security, and compliance with internal standards and business expectations.
- Drive ITIL-based incident, problem, change, and service transition processes, including escalation leadership for complex or high-impact service issues.
- Resolve complex operational problems, improve procedures, and facilitate clear communication across technical teams, service owners, vendors, and business stakeholders.
- Define, monitor, and improve service levels, KPIs, metrics, operational health measures, and action plans that improve service performance and customer experience.
- Continuously identify opportunities to standardize, automate, simplify, and improve IAM operations using practices such as ITIL, SRE, agile, automation, and continuous service improvement.
- Lead or participate as an domain SME in crisis management activities for high-impact outages, ensuring timely coordination, decision-making, stakeholder communication, and post-incident learning.
- Maintain operational documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, training plans, and reports needed to support service quality, compliance, and business continuity.
- Partner with engineering, product owners, solution managers, and security stakeholders to ensure new capabilities are supportable, secure, measurable, and ready for operational transition.
- Provide vendor and partner oversight, ensuring support teams meet service expectations, follow approved processes, maintain documentation quality, and execute work within agreed operating models.
- Keep current on industry’s best practices and adhere to the latest design best practices, strategies, technologies, and industry changes.

Position-Specific Responsibilities
- Active Directory Operations: Oversee operational support, stability, security, hardening, monitoring, backup, auditing, disaster recovery readiness, and other operational aspects for enterprise Active Directory environments.
- Entra ID Operations: Support operational excellence for Entra ID capabilities including enterprise applications, application registrations, service principals, Graph API permissions, Conditional Access, PIM, MFA, Windows Hello for Business, Entra Connect, and identity synchronization.
- Active Directory Services Security: Lead or coordinate remediation of Active Directory security findings, implementation of secure baseline requirements, GPO governance, privileged access controls, Tier model alignment, and ongoing hardening efforts.
- Service Operations and Escalation: Ensure Level 2 and Level 3 teams effectively triage, route, troubleshoot, resolve, and document incidents, requests, and changes in ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.
- Operational Resilience: Ensure appropriate monitoring, alerting, backups, recovery procedures, continuity documentation, and disaster recovery exercises are maintained for IAM-owned services.
- Automation and Process Improvement: Drive automation, scripting, data hygiene, operational reporting, and simplification of recurring operational activities to improve quality, speed, and reliability.
- Change and Release Execution: Plan, approve, coordinate, and validate changes such as platform upgrades, patches, hardening activities, service migrations, tooling transitions, and operational improvements.
- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with IAM service owners, engineering, architecture, security operations, application teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and regional operations teams to deliver best-in-class service outcomes.

Job Qualifications
Required:
- 5+ years of IT experience, with at least 3 years focused within IAM and/or Active Directory, to include but not limited to: - LDAP
- Active Directory Users & Computers
- Domain Controllers
- PowerShell
- GPO
- Windows Server 2019/'22/'25.

- At least 1 year of experience working within an IT Operations focused role - Maintaining and patching servers
- Fulfilling and answering SNOW tickets
- Responding to IT emergencies impacting the business
- Safeguarding availability of AD services to the business
- Defining and executing service improvement ideas/plans
- Tracking & Improving service health metrics

- Able to define strategy and leads the delivery and transformation of business outcomes through IT within major business/organization services, products, or programs.
- Ability to work hybrid schedule in Cincinnati, OH based office.

Preferred:
- Certifications: MS Certified in applicable technology, ITIL V4 or V5, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), CISSP, or any other applicable information security related certifcates.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or related field.
